notes: BASE LIST PRICES: $99 / $145 / $255 / $369 for $25K / $50K / $100K / $150K. Expiring promotions and the five-account bundle discount are excluded from single-account base prices.
ONE-TIME AND $0 ACTIVATION: Growth has no subscription rebill and no simulated-funded activation fee.
SIX-PERCENT TARGET: $1,500 / $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000 by tier.
SOFT DAILY LOSS: $600 / $1,250 / $2,500 / $3,750; reaching it stops trading for the day rather than failing the account by itself.
EOD TRAILING LOSS: $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,500 / $5,000; tier-specific dollar caps remain in accountSizes rather than a false shared percentage.
ONE-DAY PASS: Growth evaluation has no consistency rule and can pass after one trading day. The 35% stored value is the simulated-funded payout gate.
PAYOUT GATE: every request cycle needs five qualifying profit days with $100 / $150 / $200 / $250 minimum daily profit by tier.
NINETY-PERCENT SPLIT: simulated-funded requests pay 90% to the trader; Elite Live uses 80/20.
DAY TRADING ONLY: positions must close by 4:45 PM ET, so overnight and weekend holding are prohibited.
NEWS ALLOWED: the separate microscalping payout gate requires over 50% of trades and over 50% of profit to come from trades longer than 10 seconds.
AUTOMATION AND COPYING RESTRICTED: a provably personal non-HFT bot is conditional; copy trading is limited to accounts the trader owns and manages.
ALL SALES FINAL: purchases, resets and other fees are non-refundable.
